items.description: The loader declares a `## Review Extras` block with an explicit consumption contract — the invoking skill spawns one reviewer per entry, passing its criteria verbatim. No skill does: review Phase 1 spawns a fixed bugs/security/tests set and never reads the block, and review is the only skill here. `## Data Sources` on line 15 is the same defect — declared with a stated purpose and no execution site anywhere in the plugin. A project authoring either block gets silence.
Phase 1 spawns `geniro:coverage-agent`. agents/ holds one file, reviewer-agent.md, and nothing defines a coverage agent. The spawn cannot resolve, so the coverage map Phase 1 promises never exists.

Phase 3 offers a `--legacy` flag and MIGRATION.md:5 tells users to pass it, but the frontmatter argument-hint declares only `[branch | PR number | empty for the working diff]` and no phase parses `$ARGUMENTS` for a flag at all. The flag is promised in two places and wired in none.

The agent description promises confidence-scored findings. Its body asks for the table plus a two-sentence verdict and never mentions confidence, and skills/_shared/finding-schema.md defines no confidence column. The description advertises an output the contract cannot produce.
